observations: The rewritten background sentence now trails off mid-clause: 'background life stays soft and does not compete with the.' — the same truncation pattern that caused the wardrobe defect, now in the background field; it should end with a full word such as 'speakers'.

The rewritten continuity sentence ends 'white collared shirt and sky-blue.' — it drops 'tie' and Sarah's brunette professional bob, so her locked outfit is named incompletely; the fixed in_frame sentence still carries Nadia's full wardrobe, which covers finding 3, but Sarah's outfit clause should en

The motion prompt was also rewritten with Sarah's exact position and a static ending frame; the motion layer was not under review on this still-layer rewrite, but its new words are consistent with the still.
No readable text appears anywhere in the prompts; the only markings are the blank ledger and blank screens, which carry no writing.
review.cause: The still prompt's continuity clause trailed off mid-sentence ('the green ledger is') leaving Nadia's outfit unfinished for the model to invent, and named Sarah only as 'a shoulder at the frame edge' with no side, no visible parts and no outfit, so the model dropped her from the frame.
review.lesson: Write every clause of the prompt as a complete sentence that ends with its final word — the last garment, the last named object — so no description trails off mid-sentence for the model to finish.
